newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-FIFA TURNS DOWN BOSNIAN REQUEST TO HOST WORLD CUP MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIFA TURNS DOWN BOSNIAN REQUEST TO HOST WORLD CUP MATCH.

text.p: FIFA, soccer's world governing body, said on Wednesday it had turned down a request by Bosnia to play next month's World Cup qualifying match against Croatia in Sarajevo.
Instead, the European Group One clash between the former Balkan enemies will be held as planned on October 9 in the neutral venue of Bologna, Italy.

After successfully staging an international athletics meeting earlier this month in the war-ravaged Sarajevo stadium, Bosnian soccer officials lobbied FIFA to have the game returned to the city which hosted the 1984 Winter Olympics.
"It will definitely be played in Italy as planned," FIFA spokesman Keith Cooper said. "There were several requests to change the venue but I can confirm it will be played in Italy.
"In fact we have a meeting with the Italians tomorrow which confirms they will be doing the organising."
